camel_example: aliyun dcdn ModifyDcdnWafPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --PolicyName policy_test --PolicyStatus on --PolicyId 1000001
description_en: Modifies the name or status of a specified mitigation policy
description_zh: 调用ModifyDcdnWafPolicy修改指定防护策略名称或状态
kebab_example: aliyun dcdn modify-dcdn-waf-policy --policy-id 1000001 --policy-name policy_test --policy-status on --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDcdnWafPolicy

parameters.help_en: The ID of the mitigation policy that you want to modify. You can specify only one ID
parameters.help_zh: 需要修改的防护策略ID，仅支持单个输入
parameters.name: policy_id

parameters.help_en:
The new name of the mitigation policy.

> You must specify this parameter or PolicyStatus
parameters.help_zh:
修改后的防护策略名称。

>该参数与PolicyStatus至少传一个
parameters.name: policy_name

parameters.help_en:
The new status of the mitigation policy. Valid values:

- **on**: Enabled.
- **off**: Disabled.

> You must specify this parameter or PolicyName
parameters.help_zh:
修改后的防护策略状态，取值：

- **on**：开启。

- **off**：关闭。

>该参数与PolicyName至少传一个
parameters.name: policy_status
